data.name: plays_stats_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER plays_stats_insert AFTER INSERT ON plays BEGIN
  INSERT INTO play_stats (path, play_count, first_played_at, last_played_at)
    VALUES (new.path, 1, new.played_at, new.played_at)
    ON CONFLICT (path) DO UPDATE SET play_count = play_count + 1,
      first_played_at = min(first_played_at, excluded.first_played_at),
      last_played_at = max(last_played_at, excluded.last_played_at);
END;

CREATE TRIGGER tracks_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search ON tracks
WHEN old.title_sort IS NOT new.title_sort
  OR old.artist_search IS NOT new.artist_search
  OR old.album_search IS NOT new.album_search
  OR old.album_artist_search IS NOT new.album_artist_search
  OR old.genre_search IS NOT new.genre_search
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO track_search(track_search, rowid, title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search)
  VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title_sort, old.artist_search, old.album_search, old.album_artist_search, old.genre_search);
  INSERT INTO track_search(rowid, title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search)
  VALUES (new.id, new.title_sort, new.artist_search, new.album_search, new.album_artist_search, new.genre_search);
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plays" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "listened_ms" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_stats" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "play_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("path"));

CREATE TRIGGER plays_stats_insert AFTER INSERT ON plays BEGIN INSERT INTO play_stats (path, play_count, first_played_at, last_played_at) VALUES (new.path, 1, new.played_at, new.played_at) ON CONFLICT (path) DO UPDATE SET play_count = play_count + 1, first_played_at = min(first_played_at, excluded.first_played_at), last_played_at = max(last_played_at, excluded.last_played_at);END

CREATE TRIGGER plays_stats_delete AFTER DELETE ON plays BEGIN UPDATE play_stats SET play_count = play_count - 1, first_played_at = coalesce((SELECT min(played_at) FROM plays WHERE path = old.path), first_played_at), last_played_at = coalesce((SELECT max(played_at) FROM plays WHERE path = old.path), last_played_at) WHERE path = old.path;DELETE FROM play_stats WHERE path = old.path AND play_count <= 0;END

CREATE TRIGGER plays_stats_update AFTER UPDATE OF path, played_at ON plays WHEN old.path IS NOT new.path OR old.played_at IS NOT new.played_at BEGIN UPDATE play_stats SET play_count = play_count - 1, first_played_at = coalesce((SELECT min(played_at) FROM plays WHERE path = old.path), first_played_at), last_played_at = coalesce((SELECT max(played_at) FROM plays WHERE path = old.path), last_played_at) WHERE path = old.path;DELETE FROM play_stats WHERE path = old.path AND play_count <= 0;INSERT INTO play_stats (path, play_count, first_played_at, last_played_at) VALUES (new.path, 1, new.played_at, new.played_at) ON CONFLICT (path) DO UPDATE SET play_count = play_count + 1, first_played_at = min(first_played_at, excluded.first_played_at), last_played_at = max(last_played_at, excluded.last_played_at);END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX plays_path_played ON plays (path, played_at)
CREATE INDEX plays_played_at ON plays (played_at, path)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX playlists_favorites_unique ON playlists (kind) WHERE kind = 'favorites'
CREATE INDEX playlist_entries_order ON playlist_entries (playlist_id, position)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_roots" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_scan_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "root_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_roots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mtime_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "album_artist" TEXT NULL, "track_no" INTEGER NULL, "track_total" INTEGER NULL, "disc_no" INTEGER NULL, "disc_total" INTEGER NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "composer" TEXT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "bitrate" INTEGER NULL, "sample_rate" INTEGER NULL, "bit_depth" INTEGER NULL, "channels" INTEGER NULL, "extra_tags" TEXT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scan_error" TEXT NULL, "cover_key" TEXT NULL, "cover_scan_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "album_artist_key" TEXT NULL, "album_title_key" TEXT NULL, "album_display_artist" TEXT NULL, "title_sort" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "artist_sort" TEXT NULL, "album_sort" TEXT NULL, "artist_search" TEXT NULL, "album_search" TEXT NULL, "album_artist_search" TEXT NULL, "genre_search" TEXT NULL, "keys_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_search" USING fts5(title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search, content='tracks', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 0', prefix='1 2 3');

CREATE TRIGGER tracks_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON tracks BEGIN INSERT INTO track_search ("rowid", title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search) VALUES (new.id, new.title_sort, new.artist_search, new.album_search, new.album_artist_search, new.genre_search);END

CREATE TRIGGER tracks_search_delete AFTER DELETE ON tracks BEGIN INSERT INTO track_search (track_search, "rowid", title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title_sort, old.artist_search, old.album_search, old.album_artist_search, old.genre_search);END

CREATE TRIGGER tracks_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search ON tracks WHEN old.title_sort IS NOT new.title_sort OR old.artist_search IS NOT new.artist_search OR old.album_search IS NOT new.album_search OR old.album_artist_search IS NOT new.album_artist_search OR old.genre_search IS NOT new.genre_search BEGIN INSERT INTO track_search (track_search, "rowid", title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title_sort, old.artist_search, old.album_search, old.album_artist_search, old.genre_search);INSERT INTO track_search ("rowid", title_sort, artist_search, album_search, album_artist_search, genre_search) VALUES (new.id, new.title_sort, new.artist_search, new.album_search, new.album_artist_search, new.genre_search);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_artists" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "artist_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("artist_key", "track_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cover_colors" ("cover_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "seed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "palette" TEXT NOT NULL, "algo_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cover_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "excluded_folders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX tracks_root ON tracks (root_id)
CREATE INDEX tracks_title_sort ON tracks (title_sort, id)
CREATE INDEX tracks_album_key ON tracks (album_artist_key, album_title_key)
CREATE INDEX tracks_keys_version ON tracks (keys_version)
CREATE INDEX tracks_language ON tracks (language)
CREATE INDEX tracks_added_at ON tracks (added_at)
CREATE INDEX track_artists_track ON track_artists (track_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyric_translations" ("content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_lang" TEXT NULL, "lines_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_hash", "provider", "target_lang"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyric_translation_prefs" ("content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_lang" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_hash"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "online_lyrics" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_id" TEXT NULL, "synced_text" TEXT NULL, "plain_text" TEXT NULL, "instrumental" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("instrumental" IN (0, 1)), "remote_duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key", "provider_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_pins" ("track_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NULL, "remote_id" TEXT NULL, "synced_text" TEXT NULL, "plain_text" TEXT NULL, "instrumental" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("instrumental" IN (0, 1)), "remote_duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "pinned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "online_lyrics_rejects" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "rejected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key", "provider_id", "remote_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_plugins" ("install_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "api_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hosts" TEXT NOT NULL, "config_schema" TEXT NOT NULL, "package_dir" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "repo_url" TEXT NULL, "repo_slug" TEXT NULL, "installed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "removed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("install_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_source_prefs" ("provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_plugin_repos" ("url" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "catalog" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("url"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_plugin_data" ("install_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "config_values" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "storage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("install_id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lyrics_plugins_repo_unique ON lyrics_plugins (repo_url, repo_slug) WHERE repo_url IS NOT NULL
